notes_for_editor: Record us-ca-bald-mountain appears to duplicate data/towers/ca/us-ca-bald-mountain-sequoia-nf.json (same NHLR lookout, coordinates within about 0.1 km); suggest merging. County conflict: record says Kern, NHLR says Tulare, Kemnow groups it under Kern; left uncorrected for a human to check. Build year: NHLR 1954 vs fire-lookouts.org 1955 for the present structure; listing date NHLR 2001 vs fire-lookouts.org 1999. Staffing: FS page says manned (undated page; as_of is the read date); the duplicate record says volunteer, and fire-lookouts.org says staffed full time in fire season (undated). A 1953 newspaper item on a Bald Mountain fire lookout (Kemnow page) is left out because it names a private individual and concerns a claim later withdrawn; editor may decide. fire-lookouts.org 2009-2011 text says Sierra National Forest in one place (apparent typo). height_m 12.2 is the tower height given by the register; cab floor height not stated.
